description: This file defines a static class 'XColors' that provides a collection of 141 pre-defined RGB colors as static properties, each returning an XColor instance initialized with a known color enumeration. It serves as a color palette specific to the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace, facilitating easy access to commonly used colors in PDF rendering.

classes.name: XColors
classes.description: A static class providing predefined colors as properties.
